mapper.update: UPDATE user_quota SET interview_free_used = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE deleted = false
UPDATE user_quota SET resume_chat_free_used = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE deleted = false
UPDATE user_quota SET interview_paid = CASE WHEN interview_paid > 0 THEN interview_paid - 1 ELSE 0 END, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = false
UPDATE user_quota SET resume_chat_paid = CASE WHEN resume_chat_paid > 0 THEN resume_chat_paid - 1 ELSE 0 END, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = false

UPDATE user_quota SET interview_free_used = CASE WHEN interview_free_used < #{limit} THEN interview_free_used + 1 ELSE interview_free_used END, interview_paid = CASE WHEN interview_free_used >= #{limit} AND interview_paid > 0 THEN interview_paid - 1 ELSE interview_paid END, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = false AND (interview_free_used < #{limit} OR interview_paid > 0)

UPDATE user_quota SET resume_chat_free_used = CASE WHEN resume_chat_free_used < #{limit} THEN resume_chat_free_used + 1 ELSE resume_chat_free_used END, resume_chat_paid = CASE WHEN resume_chat_free_used >= #{limit} AND resume_chat_paid > 0 THEN resume_chat_paid - 1 ELSE resume_chat_paid END, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = false AND (resume_chat_free_used < #{limit} OR resume_chat_paid > 0)
UPDATE user_quota SET interview_paid = interview_paid - 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = false AND interview_paid > 0
UPDATE user_quota SET resume_chat_paid = resume_chat_paid - 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = false AND resume_chat_paid > 0
